test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 27 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the idiom that gives the most appropriate meaning of the underlined phrase in the following sentence.**

'Honesty is the best policy' does not **__remain valid__** in the present times of corruption and greed.
solution:
The correct answer is "Hold good."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• **"Hold good" **typically means to remain valid or applicable. (वैध या लागू रहना)
 
• For example, if someone says,** ***"The warranty on this product **holds good**__ for one year,"*** **it means that the warranty remains valid or effective for one year.
 
• It can also imply that something is reliable or trustworthy, as in *"His advice always __**holds good**__ in challenging situations."*
 
• The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Go through thick and thin: **to stay loyal and supportive of someone or something in both good and bad times, regardless of the difficulties or challenges faced. (कठिनाइयों या चुनौतियों का सामना किए बिना, अच्छे समय और बुरे समय दोनों में किसी व्यक्ति या चीज़ के प्रति वफादार और सहायक बने रहना)
 
• **Put up: **to place or hang something in a specific location. (किसी वस्तु को किसी विशिष्ट स्थान पर रखना या लटकाना)
 
• **Keep pace with: **to stay at the same speed or level of progress as something else, usually in terms of development, progress, or activity. (आमतौर पर विकास, प्रगति या गतिविधि के संदर्भ में किसी अन्य चीज़ की समान गति या प्रगति के स्तर पर बने रहना)

43:Tf29,

The correct answer is "endure."
